title: The robot's health
prompt: Declare a variable at the top of the script, outside any function (a member variable), called `health` and equal to 100. Then make `robot_health` return it.
hints: A variable written outside every function belongs to the whole script.
`var health = 100` on the first line, above robot_health.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.
